_comment: THREE PILLARS P5: the milestone's own end-to-end proof of the FIELD-SKILL LOOP. Loads the near_tactician fixture (warrior L1 at the inn, studied_the_cellar banked, [Basic Cleaning] innate) via the title 'Continue'. PHASE A proves the overworld hotbar itself: it renders at load (slots:1, the innate [Basic Cleaning]); a NUMBER KEY on the faced dirty_table fires the exact interact stream (P1 byte-parity: skill_used{basic_cleaning,dirty_table} + accomplishment cleaned_the_inn + the same toast); and a number key facing empty floor takes the field_ambient fallback. PHASE B proves the earned-class arc: one sleep resolves TWO gained_by gates at once -- the pre-banked studied_the_cellar grants [Tactician] and Phase A's fresh cleaned_the_inn:1 grants [Helper] (a genuine emergent co-grant: the loop earns Helper by doing the chore) -- so the hotbar RE-RENDERS from 1 field slot to THREE ([Basic Cleaning], [Helper]'s [Basic Cooking], [Tactician]'s [Observe], in catalog order). Pressing [Observe]'s slot (3) on Erin surfaces her exact observe string as a toast and reveals the skill in the journal (used_skills). No combat anywhere -- fixture rng_state governs, --seed is cosmetic; seed 9 for convention.

steps._comment: == PHASE A: hotbar renders 1 innate slot; field dispatch (parity) + ambient fallback ==
Face dirty_table (5,4): right3 -> (5,3), down1 blocks on the table & faces it.
Ambient fallback: left1 -> (4,3) facing the empty (3,3); the number key takes basic_cleaning's field_ambient line (no target, banks nothing).

payload_contains.text: [Basic Cleaning] — You wipe down the nearest surface out of old habit. It gleams.

steps._comment: == PHASE B: one sleep grants [Tactician] (pre-banked studied_the_cellar) AND [Helper] (Phase A's cleaned_the_inn:1); hotbar re-renders 1 -> 3 field slots ==. (4,3) left2 -> (2,3), down3 -> (2,6), down1 blocks on the bed (2,7) & faces it, interact -> sleep.
Face Erin (7,2): up3 -> (2,3), right5 -> (7,3), up1 blocks on Erin & faces her.
Slot 3 is [Observe] (catalog order: innate basic_cleaning, then helper's basic_cooking, then tactician's observe -- basic_cooking is field-tagged too). Press it facing Erin.
steps.name: hotbar_3

payload_contains.text: A young human, no armor, no weapon, no idea she is the strangest thing in this world. She moves like someone still deciding to be brave. The inn already leans toward her.

steps._comment: Journal reveal: both field skills used this run are now in used_skills (basic_cleaning from Phase A's dispatch, observe from this [Observe]).
